name: tide_front
description: Single game VFX sprite: broad wall of liquid turquoise water traveling RIGHT (east), seen from low top-down RPG camera. Wide crescent bow, pointed upper and lower ends sweep backward to left, foamy pale mint leading rim at right, dark teal transparent water depth behind rim, separated spray beads. This is a vertical bow spanning about 52 pixels in height and 28 pixels in width, centered on a 64x64 transparent canvas. Strong hand-clustered pixel art, same cyan teal as a small aqua slime, restrained pale foam, dark selective teal outline. Clearly WATER, not a sword or spinning disk. No environment, no character, no rectangular background, no blur, no text.

name: water_finisher
description: Single compact game VFX sprite: two sharp curved blades made entirely of turquoise WATER crossing in an X, projected RIGHT (east), low top-down action RPG. Two distinct pale mint cutting rims cross in a bright central impact knot, dark teal water channels behind them, a few cyan droplets trailing left. Crisp pixel-art clusters with thin dark teal selective outlines, luminous mint foam NOT white bloom. Compact 34 pixel by 34 pixel core centered on transparent 48x48 canvas. Slime water attack finisher, NOT metal swords, no handles, no straight weapons, no character, no environment, no glow haze, no lettering.

name: guard_membrane
description: Single pixel-art game status VFX overlay, low top-down RPG. A protective segmented liquid shell around an EMPTY TRANSPARENT center: four small olive-gold armored water scales curl along left and right sides of an implied 36px round slime. Center must remain empty so character face is visible underneath. Upper rim has two delicate gold glints, lower curved rim is shallow dark teal with olive-gold corners, most of canvas transparent. Centered symmetrical 44px wide 40px tall effect on transparent 64x64. Deliberate crisp pixel clusters, 8-12 colors dark teal, muted brass, soft pale gold. No character, no solid shield object, no filled circle, no text, no blur, no rectangle, no scenery.

name: spitter_current
description: Single pixel-art game status VFX overlay for fast water casting, low top-down RPG. Three small liquid turquoise streams orbit around an EMPTY TRANSPARENT center for a 36px round slime. Curved cyan spray strokes on left and right, tiny pale mint bubbles follow each arc, a shallow rippling crescent along lower edge. Center stays transparent for face underneath. Centered 44px wide 40px tall effect in transparent 64x64. Crisp hand-clustered pixel art, dark teal selective outline, rich turquoise body and restrained pale mint highlights. No character, no solid circle, no arrows, no text, no glowing haze, no scenery.
